title: FaST: Efficient and Effective Long-Horizon Forecasting for Large-Scale Spatial-Temporal Graphs via Mixture-of-Experts
text: (i) temporal-centric methods that model time-series dynamics without explicit spatial structures, including DLinear (Zeng et al. , 2023 ) : decomposes a series into trend and residual components and models them with lightweight linear projections; NHITS (Challu et al. , 2023 ) : performs multi-rate processing with hierarchical interpolation for multihorizon forecasting; and CycleNet (Lin et al. , 2024 ) : uses a cycle-consistency objective to better capture periodic patterns. (ii) spatial-temporal-centric methods , including DCRNN (Li et al. , 2018 ) : combines diffusion graph convolution with a sequence-to-sequence architecture for spatiotemporal modeling; STGCN (Yu et al. , 2018 ) : models spatiotemporal correlations via graph and temporal convolutions; GWNet (Wu et al. , 2019 ) : integrates gated temporal convolutions with adaptive graph convolutions; SGP (Cini et al. , 2023 ) : uses randomized recurrent components with GNNs for scalable learning on large graphs; STID (Shao et al. , 2022 ) : augments simple MLPs with spatial/temporal identity cues to mitigate sample indistinguishability; STDMAE (Gao et al. , 2024 ) : applies decoupled masked autoencoding to reconstruct sequences along spatial and temporal dimensions; BigST (Han et al. , 2024b ) : introduces long-sequence feature extraction and linearized global spatial convolution for large-scale networks; RPMixer (Yeh et al. , 2024 ) : leverages random projections and a mixer architecture to build a lightweight model; STPGNN (Kong et al. , 2024 ) : selects pivotal nodes and uses parallel convolutions to capture spatiotemporal dependencies in traffic data; and PatchSTG (Fang
